name: Monosodium Glutamate (MSG)
description: A flavor enhancer used in many processed foods. While generally recognized as safe (GRAS) by the FDA, some people report sensitivity symptoms (MSG symptom complex).

name: Tartrazine
description: A synthetic lemon yellow azo dye. Known to cause allergic-type reactions, particularly in those with aspirin sensitivity or asthma.
source: WHO International Programme on Chemical Safety (IPCS)

name: Sodium Nitrite
description: Used as a preservative and color fixative in cured meats. Can form nitrosamines when heated, which are potentially carcinogenic.
source: WHO International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC)
